liz-p: quick sync — we need to finalize the runtime metric names + tags for the new per-route performance panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). cc @console-ux @ash-k @dmitri :eyes:
ash-k: +1 — are we emitting histograms or pre-computed percentiles?
dmitri: prefer histograms (Prom histogram or hdr) at the source so we can slice/rollup. percentiles in app are ok for sanity checks but not for dashboard slicing. main constraints: label cardinality and token counting hygiene.
console-ux: UX needs: default aggregated route view, route dropdown to drill down, toggle to overlay rollout windows (canary vs prod), and an option to group by model variant. we need a stable label for model_variant.
liz-p: agreement: runtime should emit these metric names (suggestion):
```
route.request_count
route.latency_ms.histogram  # for P50/P95/P99 derivation
route.ttft_ms.histogram
route.tokens_generated.count
route.active_seconds.gauge  # for tokens/sec calc
route.error_count
```
with tags: `route_id`, `model_name`, `model_variant`, `region`, `customer_tier`. keep them small and normalized.
ash-k: tokens/sec semantics question — do we want tokens/sec per request, or tokens/sec as throughput (tokens / active_seconds window)?
dmitri: we intend tokens/sec = sum(tokens_generated) / sum(active_seconds) over the aggregation window (default 1m). active_seconds should be the wallclock GPU-inference time (seconds) rather than wall time to avoid idle wait skew. for streaming we count tokens as produced, and active_seconds includes streaming transmission time.
console-ux: cardinality concern: some routes have request parameters that would explode tags. proposal: runtime emits `route_id` (stable short slug) only; any param-level breakdowns should be computed in analytics layered exports, not as tags. if a customer wants param-slice in dashboard, we'll offer a sampled event feed.
liz-p: sampling: plan is full (100%) for request_count+latency buckets for production routes flagged as SLO-critical; for non-critical routes we can do 10% sampling. for p99 tail accuracy we want tail-sampler that preserves high-latency events.
dmitri: implementation note — prefer hdrhistogram at runtime, emit compressed buckets once per request with tags; exporter will decode and feed Prom histograms. alternative is the runtime to update internal histograms in-process and emit aggregated histograms every 30s for each route. both ok, tradeoffs: network size vs prometheus cardinality.
runtime-bot: draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/452 — adds `route.*` metrics, labels, and hdr emit. contains example emitter payload. :white_check_mark:
ash-k: quick nit: metric names should use snake_case and end in units (_ms, _count, _seconds) — matches infra conventions.
liz-p: noted. i'll update the spec and push a Console dashboard PR template to match panels (P50/P95/P99 line charts, TTFT heatmap, tokens/sec bar). target: runtime PR by EOD Friday, console PR by next Wed, rollouts/QA Thurs next week.
console-ux: can we get a sample payload to mock panels? helps front-end wireframes.
dmitri: sample emitter (json line):
```
{"metric": "route.latency_ms.histogram", "buckets": "hdr:...", "tags": {"route_id":"chat-complete","model_name":"redwood-8k","model_variant":"v2-canary","region":"us-west1","customer_tier":"prod"}, "request_id":"req-42"}
```
will send a few synthetic lines to the dashboard playground.
liz-p: next steps: dmitri to post sample payloads + size estimates; ash to validate tokens/sec definition against billing; runtime to add `model_variant` label and tail-sampler opt-in flag; console-ux to draft panel templates. i'll schedule 30m handoff Wed. thanks :pray:
runtime-bot: posted synthetic emitter data to https://grafana.playground/redwood/samples (10 lines)
console-ux: saw them, layout looks good. small ask — add rollout windows as an annotation stream (timestamp ranges) so we can overlay on charts.
liz-p: will add to the dashboard PR checklist.
